verdict.rationale: Bulk import is documented: writes accept a column-based upsert format where each key is a column (docs-24), and long operations can run asynchronously (docs-34). Export is not documented as its own capability. The evidence shows only server-side namespace-to-namespace copies across regions and clouds (docs-33, docs-11) and result pagination with `offset` (docs-6), not an export to files or a defined format. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-export endpoint or file format for vectors plus metadata, documented import from files or object storage, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale import/export.
